title: Being Alone Not in a lonely, despressed, or sad way, but in a way that celebrates independence and self-discovery.

commenti.body: In a weird way, 500 Days of Summer fits this theme. Summer makes it clear throughout the movie that she's perfectly happy being alone; she says "I don't want to be anybody's anything," and the narrator says something like "the only thing she loved more than her beautiful long hair was the fact that she could cut it off and feel nothing." The guy obviously doesn't listen to her and tries to pursue her anyway, and things get hella messed up, but Summer strikes me as a very independent character who isn't looking for another person.

Thanks for sharing your take! 500 Days of Summer totally aligns with the theme. She's clear about being content alone. Despite the guy's pursuit. Honestly it just didnt come to mind while writing this.
